verdicts.evidence: The environment comparison in s1 sets forceFailOnNonZero, which controls process.exit(1) when the build fails at f1:20-23. This is an environment gate deciding whether a failed optional build terminates installation with failure instead of reaching process.exit(0) at f1:27.

The test in s2 reads forceFailOnNonZero, bound at f1:5 to whether process.env.CI_CHECK_FAIL equals 'ssh2'. On build failure it gates process.exit(1); otherwise execution reaches process.exit(0) at f1:27, so it is part of an environment gate controlling installation failure.
